post.title: 321,000 more Americans quit their jobs in September
post.ig:
321,000 more Americans quit their jobs in September.
That's the biggest one-month jump in quits since May 2023, per the Labor Department's JOLTS report out today.
Total quits: 3.4 million. Quits rate: 2.1%, versus 2.9% in September 2021.
The catch: about 197,000 of the extra quits came from restaurants and hotels.
Job openings: 7.5 million, up from 7.2 million in August.
Sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, JOLTS, Nov 3, 2026.
